metadata.title: How I Trained a Competitive Pokémon AI Agent Using a MacBook in Less Than 2 Months! From Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning to Search: Reaching the Top 25 in Gen 9 OU on the Pokémon Showdown Simulator
metadata.description:
A first-person technical blog post from Team LittleStar describing how a compact (12.76M-parameter) Pokémon battle agent was built on a MacBook Pro M4 Pro and one small CPU server, coordinated with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok), and evaluated on the public Pokémon Showdown Gen 9 OU ladder.

The post covers three approaches: (I) distilling the 142.7M-parameter Kakuna agent into a small student with DAgger-style training and selecting a confirmed eight-team repertoire (Champion-8); (II) reinforcement learning with PPO against a curriculum of hard opponents; and (III) Gumbel search at decision time plus MuZero-style selective Reanalyse to distill searched decisions into successive networks (SD2). Before Showdown's October 20, 2026 bot opt-in matchmaking change, a Search(H8) agent was captured at rank #21 and an SD2-Search(SD2.3) agent finished a 107-game run at 79–28 (Elo 1867) and was captured at rank #22. Controlled results, limitations, and references are included.

This record archives version 1.0.0 of the post as published at the related URL.
